vulnerable_statements.reason: link->link_enc is dereferenced without a NULL check. A link can have no link encoder bound to it, for example when encoders are assigned dynamically (USB4/DPIA or a link that is not yet assigned). Then link_enc is NULL and dereferencing it to reach funcs->validate_output_with_stream causes a NULL pointer dereference and a kernel oops.

suggested_fix: Check that link->link_enc is non-NULL before dereferencing it, e.g. `if (link->ep_type == DISPLAY_ENDPOINT_PHY && link->link_enc && !link->link_enc->funcs->validate_output_with_stream(link->link_enc, stream))`. Or, if no encoder is available, return an error such as DC_FAIL_ENC_VALIDATE. Defensively, also check that stream->link and tg are non-NULL before using them.
